authorization: No live, attachment, callback or capture implementation authorized by this plan.
prerequisites: Specific native boundary and independent field meanings must be reviewed before any instrumented trial.
Exact player/image/SWF/build identity; unique owned process and no reused historical tag.
Input-consumption and random tape comparability currently unproved: observation timestamps alone cannot qualify an off/on pair.

stages.name: offline-source-bytecode
require: Original predicate/goto/action counts and short-circuit logic preserved
No forced timeline, global API override or guessed field offset

stages.name: paired-off-on-design
require: Fixed initial state and pinned consumed input/RNG, or explicitly mark comparison unqualified
Same independent output/behavior checks in both modes
Keep failed/partial/raw logs and noncomparable runs; no threshold adjustment

stages.name: identity-negative-controls
require: Reject path/depth/address reuse and generation changes
Separate callback and logger replacement from dispatcher outcome
Do not insert controls into locked game or execute them under this plan

stages.name: independent-observer-check
require: Independent witness must survive loss/replacement of source logger
Report raw-memory/debugger limitations and observer effects
Absence of witness is unknown, not destruction/return

stages.name: bounded-owned-host-plan
require: Separately reviewed scoped approval; no signature/security changes or software fallback
Retain breakpoint/attach/detach/cleanup receipts for exact owned process
Timeout, denial, focus/identity loss fail closed without retry

admission: Passing a future control does not itself close M0-02 or certify ticks/OS join.
